items.source: If Role is present on a @Configuration class, this indicates the role of the configuration class bean definition and does not cascade to all @Bean methods defined within. This behavior is different from the behavior of the @Lazy annotation, for example.
items.translation: 如果 `@Configuration` 类上存在 `Role`，则表明配置类 Bean 定义的角色，且该行为不会级联到内部定义的 @Bean 方法。此行为与 @Lazy 注解的行为不同。

items.source: May be used on any class directly or indirectly annotated with Component or on methods annotated with Bean.
items.translation: 可用于任何直接或间接使用Component注解的类，或使用Bean注解的方法。

items.source: If this annotation is not present on a Component or Bean definition, the default value of BeanDefinition.ROLE_APPLICATION will apply.
items.translation: 如果该注解未出现在组件或 Bean 定义上，则默认应用BeanDefinition.ROLE_APPLICATION的值。

items.source: Set the role hint for the associated bean.
items.translation: 为关联的 Bean 设置角色提示。
